data_as_of: Pre-market quotes from StockAnalysis.com quote API (~7:49 a.m. CT Nov 19) cross-checked with Yahoo Finance v7 (~7:45 a.m. CT); futures, VIX, 10Y, DXY, oil, gold ~7:38 a.m. CT and Bitcoin ~7:48 a.m. CT (Yahoo). Prior closes are Wednesday Nov 18.
headline: Nasdaq futures up ~1.7% as Anthropic's record IPO revives the AI and chip trade, Palo Alto jumps on a raised outlook, and Walmart slips after a narrow beat.
drivers: Futures are higher across the board, led by the Nasdaq-100 (~+1.7% at 7:38 a.m. CT; Yahoo's live blog cited ~+2%), after Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, the largest listing on record, ahead of its Nasdaq debut today under ANT. The pricing revived the AI trade: chip and AI-infrastructure names (MU, SK hynix, INTC, MRVL, LRCX, COHR, CRWV, IREN) are up 3–8% pre-market, and Nvidia is trying to snap a five-day losing streak tied to uncertainty over its leadership. Palo Alto Networks raised its FY27 revenue outlook and agreed to buy Applied Compute for $4.5B, lifting cybersecurity peers, while Walmart beat narrowly and raised its outlook but is down ~1.4%. Trump leaves the APEC summit in China with no visible movement on chip export controls, rare earths or tariffs. At 7:30 a.m. CT, initial jobless claims came in at 203K (prior 202K revised) and the Philly Fed index fell to 6.3 from 20.9 while its prices-paid gauge jumped to 58.2; the 10-year yield is ~5.09% and the VIX is down ~9% to 22.4.

notes: Run started 7:48 a.m. CT; session = PRE-MARKET. Movers use live pre-market quotes vs Wednesday's close.

Mac browser worked (WebFetch was not used). Universe: Yahoo v1 screener of 2,027 exchange-listed US stocks (NMS/NYQ/ASE/NGM/NCM; OTC excluded) with price > $5 and market cap > $2B; 947 had a pre-market quote in the last hour. Pre-market price, % and volume then taken from the StockAnalysis quote API for ~260 names (top/bottom 45 Yahoo pre-market movers plus the 200 highest-volume names) plus 16 leveraged ETFs and proxies.

Quality movers require at least 10K pre-market shares on StockAnalysis, to keep thin prints out. Left out for that reason: MNSO (−6.2%, 6.9K), DAO (−6.1%, 2.6K), HCM (+6.5%, 505 shares), PS (+5.7%, 106 shares), ENTG (Yahoo +7.1% vs SA +4.6% on 1.4K shares).

Rel vol (all tables) = pre-market volume ÷ 3-month average daily volume. It is a time-of-day fraction, not a full-session ratio. Leveraged vol_vs_avg = pre-market volume ÷ 10-day average volume (30-day not available).
Most active (shares and dollars) covers only the ~260 stocks quoted on StockAnalysis, not a full-market scan.

Gap screen applied strictly. Most of the 3%+ gappers are AI/chip/crypto sympathy moves on the Anthropic IPO with no company catalyst of a listed type, so they are under excluded. ASTS (+8.2%, B. Riley upgrade) is excluded because of its recent share-issuance/offering filing; SLS because of its $150M offering. Names with a valid catalyst but under 100K pre-market shares (P/Everpure, WSM, SA, RBRK, GLXY) are excluded on volume.

Under-$5 lists from StockAnalysis pre-market gainers/losers (exchange-listed Nasdaq names; no OTC), pre-market volume ≥ 100K. Float, last split and news from Yahoo. LICN (−15.5% at $0.01) left out: 1-for-100 reverse split effective today, so the quote is likely a split artifact. CDT was not news-checked.
Futures moved further after the snapshot: Yahoo's live blog and Investing.com had S&P futures +1.2% and Nasdaq-100 futures +2.0%. The table shows Yahoo quotes from 7:38 a.m. CT.
WMG: Investing.com said shares slipped over 4% after results, but the StockAnalysis pre-market quote shows −0.9% on 240K shares, so both figures are shown.
FNGU underlying % uses FNGS's indicative pre-market quote (no pre-market volume). Fed speaker schedule not verified. No unusual-options source was available.
No git commands were run; the Mac publish agent handles commit and push.
